title: Exoplanet Citation Atlas: a public citation-graph warehouse and 3D visualization platform for confirmed exoplanets
description: A public, daily-refreshed open-source data warehouse linking the NASA Exoplanet Archive's confirmed exoplanets to the papers that announced and characterized them. Citation coverage at 100% via a four-tier resolver (NASA ADS bibcode, arXiv API, ADS title search, manual triage); Gaia DR3 host-star enrichment; value-added literature harvests (atmospheres, derived measurements, inner-binary parameters); a FastAPI service over the warehouse; and a React + Three.js + WebXR frontend with per-vantage starfield reprojection. See README.md and CHANGELOG.md for details.
